Bright Winter.description: Striking and unforgettable. You thrive in high-contrast, vivid jewel tones that mirror a neon sky. Your presence is magnetic and clear.

True Winter.description: Absolute and striking. You possess an icy, crisp elegance. Stark, cool tones illuminate your sharp and sophisticated natural contrast.

Dark Winter.description: Mysterious and deeply captivating. You look your best wrapped in rich, cool shadows and intense, luxurious depths.

Light Spring.description: Delicate, fresh, and full of promise. You glow in airy, pastel-warm colors that capture the first soft light of day.

True Spring.description: Vibrant, golden, and blooming. Your natural warmth shines in saturated, sunny hues that radiate life and energy.

Bright Spring.description: Clear, intense, and awakening. You effortlessly carry the most vivid, warm colors, bringing a bold and joyful energy wherever you go.

Light Summer.description: Gentle, airy, and refreshing. Your cool, delicate coloring is perfectly complemented by soft, powdery tones that feel like a gentle ocean breeze.

True Summer.description: Serene, cool, and elegant. You possess a calm beauty that is beautifully enhanced by dusty, muted cool tones like lavender and slate.

Soft Summer.description: Enigmatic and softly blended. Your muted coloring is effortlessly chic, finding its perfect harmony in gentle, gray-tinted cool colors.

Soft Autumn.description: Earthy, muted, and incredibly stylish. You radiate a calm, grounded warmth that looks stunning in gentle, toasted neutrals.

True Autumn.description: Rich, golden, and abundant. You carry the warmth of changing seasons perfectly, glowing in toasted, vibrant earth tones.

Dark Autumn.description: Deep, warm, and intense. You have a smoldering natural contrast that carries the heaviest, richest autumn colors with absolute grace.
